Lo Sha allows you to test the denial aspect of Mesmers. It just happens to take the form of running an errand for him.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Mesmer
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Travel to the [[Crimson Skull camp|bandit camp]].
* Retrieve [[Ornate Box|Lo Sha's stolen gift]].
* See [[Lo Sha]] for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* You receive the following skills after accepting this quest:
** {{skill icon|Shatter Enchantment}}
** {{skill icon|Energy Tap}}

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
Follow the marker to the camp, it's just south of the exit to [[Sunqua Vale]]. Kill all Crimson Skull, make sure to bring a full party for this purpose, henchmen will do. Open the chest. No key required. Then just bring back the box. 

==Interactive objects==
*[[Chest (Lo Sha's Gift)|Chest]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Lo Sha
:''Friend, I must confide in you: I purchased a gift for [[Mei Ling]], a magnificent ornate box imbued with her favorite music, but some of those Crimson Skull thugs ambushed me on the road and stole it. Would you sneak into the '''Crimson Skull's camp''' and retrieve the '''ornate box''' for me? I would be most grateful. I only hope Mei Ling appreciated all my trouble.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll get the box back for you.
| decline = I don't think I"m ready for this task.
| ask = Hurry to the '''Crimson Skull's camp''' and retrieve the '''ornate box''' before those bandits sell it!
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Lo Sha
:''Thank you. This thing was not cheap, you know.''

==Notes==
* [[Dragon Festival]] quests have been known to interfere with the completion of this quest.
